title: Best Wildlife Sanctuaries in India
seoTitle: Best Wildlife Sanctuaries in India to Visit | Kudozz Club
metaDescription: India's most rewarding wildlife sanctuaries: Pobitora, Wayanad, Little Rann of Kutch, Kumbhalgarh, Mount Abu, Thattekad, Bhimashankar, Chinnar and more.
description: A guide to wildlife sanctuaries in India worth visiting, and how they differ from national parks: Pobitora for rhinos, Wayanad for elephants, the Little Rann's Indian Wild Ass Sanctuary, Kumbhalgarh and Mount Abu in Rajasthan, Thattekad and Chinnar in Kerala, Bhimashankar in Maharashtra, bird sanctuaries such as Ranganathittu, Vedanthangal and Nal Sarovar, with seasons.
dek: India has 573 wildlife sanctuaries. Many are quieter than the big national parks, and a few are among the best places in the country to see particular animals and birds.

hero.alt: A herd of gaur grazing on the grassy lakeshore in Periyar, Kerala

intro: Wildlife sanctuaries are protected areas declared under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972. India has 573 of them, according to the Wildlife Institute of India's database. Their rules are less strict than a national park's: some regulated activities such as grazing may be allowed. For visitors, they are often quieter, less crowded and easier to book.

Some famous places are not sanctuaries at all. Keoladeo (Bharatpur) and Sultanpur are national parks, and Jaldapara became a national park in 2014. This guide lists places that are legally sanctuaries, and names the correct status for each.
quickAnswer: Among India's wildlife sanctuaries, Pobitora in Assam has one of the densest populations of one-horned rhinos, Wayanad in Kerala is known for elephants, the Indian Wild Ass Sanctuary covers the Little Rann of Kutch, and Thattekad is one of Kerala's best birding spots. Kumbhalgarh and Mount Abu in Rajasthan, and Bhimashankar in Maharashtra, are good for forest walks and hill scenery. Most are best from October to March.
takeaways: India has 573 wildlife sanctuaries; they are less strictly protected than national parks.
Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary has a high density of rhinos close to Guwahati.
The Indian Wild Ass Sanctuary in the Little Rann of Kutch is the only home of the Indian wild ass.
Bird sanctuaries such as Ranganathittu, Vedanthangal and Nal Sarovar are best in winter.
Keoladeo and Sultanpur are national parks, not sanctuaries.

items.name: Pobitora
body: A small sanctuary about an hour or so from Guwahati with a high density of rhinos, seen by jeep or elephant.

items.name: Wayanad
body: Part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, with elephants, gaur and deer, and safaris from Muthanga and Tholpetty.

items.name: Indian Wild Ass Sanctuary
body: The salt flats of the Little Rann, the only home of the Indian wild ass (khur), explored by jeep from Dasada or Bajana.

image.alt: A kiang, the Tibetan wild ass, on the high Changthang plateau in Ladakh
image.caption: A kiang in Ladakh, a relative of the Indian wild ass

items.name: Kumbhalgarh
body: Aravalli forest around the Kumbhalgarh fort walls, with jeep drives and walks.

items.name: Thattekad
body: Also called the Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary, known for forest birds of the Western Ghats.

items.name: Ranganathittu and Vedanthangal
body: Island and lake sanctuaries where storks, ibises and herons nest in large numbers.

items.name: Nalabana on Chilika
body: A bird sanctuary island inside Chilika lake, Odisha, with flamingos and ducks in winter.

image.alt: Birds over the waters of Nalabana Bird Sanctuary on Chilika Lake
image.caption: Nalabana, Chilika Lake, Odisha

sections.heading: Sanctuary or national park?
paras: Both are declared under the Wildlife (Protection) Act. National parks do not allow grazing or private rights; sanctuaries can allow some regulated activities. A tiger reserve can include both. For visitors, the difference mostly shows in rules on walking, vehicles and stays.
after: See best national parks in India for the parks.

items.name: Binsar Wildlife Sanctuary
body: Oak and rhododendron forest in Uttarakhand's Kumaon hills, with Himalayan views and birds.

items.name: Mahananda Wildlife Sanctuary
body: Forest at the foot of the Darjeeling hills, near Siliguri, with elephants, gaur and hornbills.

items.name: Dandeli Wildlife Sanctuary
body: Part of Kali Tiger Reserve in Karnataka, known for hornbills and river trips.

items.name: Point Calimere
body: A coastal wildlife and bird sanctuary in Tamil Nadu with blackbuck and flamingos in winter.

sections.heading: Goa's sanctuaries
paras: Goa's Western Ghats forests are protected in a chain of sanctuaries along its eastern border. Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary and Mollem National Park, near Dudhsagar falls, have gaur, hornbills and butterflies; Cotigao Wildlife Sanctuary in the south has forest trails and watchtowers; Mhadei and Netravali protect the northern and southern hills. The Dr Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary on Chorao island, near Panaji, is a small mangrove reserve for birding by canoe.

items.name: Mollem guide
body: Plan a visit to Mollem and Dudhsagar.

safety: Follow the forest department's rules on walking and vehicles.
Keep a safe distance from elephants, even from a vehicle.
Carry water and sun protection in the Rann and in Rajasthan.
No park can promise a sighting; plan several drives and enjoy the forest itself.

faqs.q: How many wildlife sanctuaries are there in India?
faqs.a: 573, according to the Wildlife Institute of India's protected-area database.
It was once, but Keoladeo is now a national park and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

faqs.q: Which sanctuary is best for rhinos?
faqs.a: Pobitora in Assam has a high density of rhinos and is close to Guwahati.

faqs.q: Where can I see the Indian wild ass?
faqs.a: Only in and around the Indian Wild Ass Sanctuary in the Little Rann of Kutch, Gujarat.

faqs.q: Which is the best bird sanctuary in India?
faqs.a: It depends on the season and the birds. Thattekad suits forest birds; Ranganathittu, Vedanthangal and Nal Sarovar suit waterbirds; Keoladeo, a national park, is the most famous wetland for winter birds.

faqs.q: Are sanctuaries less crowded than national parks?
faqs.a: Usually, yes, which makes them good for relaxed visits and birding.
